```bash
# from the plugin market UI: add  dsh-office-live
# or from a checkout / tarball:
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-office-live-0.1.0.tgz
```

Then restart DSH. The tools appear in every new session.

## How it is wired

`lib/index.js` registers the seven tools with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` and shells out to
`assets/office-live.ps1`, passing `-ResultFile` (a UTF-8 side file, so Chinese text is not
mangled by the Windows console code page). The script does the COM and screenshot work and
prints one JSON object per call.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: VeriScope 离线门禁重放 · DSH 插件
plugins.readme_text:
# VeriScope 门禁重放

**中文** · [English](https://github.com/4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope/blob/main/README.en.md) · [日本語](https://github.com/4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope/blob/main/README.ja.md) · [한국어](https://github.com/4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope/blob/main/README.ko.md)

**给 AI 回答质量做发布门禁**：判定一批已经评测过的结果能不能发布，并留下可复验的回执。

- **两条通道**：重放 VeriScope 归档（调原 Python 门禁）；或仅用 Node 对任意已有逐条评分做阈值判定——不需要 VeriScope、Python 或 pandas
- **三态**：通过／失败／待复核。待复核永不转为通过，已确认失败不被附加异常掩盖
- **回执**：绑定输入、策略、判定器与环境；条件一变，旧结论自动失效
- **不评分、不调用模型**：只消费已有结果，不重新评测

[GitHub](https://github.com/4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope) · [Gitee 手动镜像](https://gitee.com/kkbushishou/dsh-plugin-veriscope) · 完整 VeriScope：[主仓库](https://github.com/4444wjt/RAG_Evaluation_Demo)／[镜像](https://gitee.com/kkbushishou/rag-hallucination-evaluator)。Issue 和 PR 请提交到 GitHub。

## 支持哪些宿主

| 宿主 | 形态 | 怎么接入 |
|---|---|---|
| **DSH** | 插件（cordis bundle） | `dsh plugin --profile <名称> add dsh-plugin-veriscope` |
| **Claude Code** | MCP server | `claude mcp add --transport stdio --env VERISCOPE_STATE_DIR=<目录> -- node <绝对路径>/mcp.js` |
| **Codex** | MCP server | `config.toml` 内加 `[mcp_servers.veriscope]` |
| **无宿主 / CI** | CLI | `veriscope-check --archive … --policy …` |

DSH、Claude Code、Codex 三种宿主均有实测调用记录；MCP 与 CLI 不提供 `bind`／`complete` 与原生结果卡。配置示例见 [MCP 接入说明](https://github.com/4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope/blob/main/docs/MCP.md)。

> **升级提示（0.4.0 起）**：旧回执的当前有效性将进入 REVIEW，历史 PASS／FAIL 不会改写。升级前请备份完整状态目录及原归档，并使用插件外的持久状态目录；包内 `.local` 可能随重装丢失，单独导出回执不是完整备份。ReceiptV1 重新 replay，ReceiptV2 重新 check，取得新版回执。

---

下方“原 VeriScope 路径”及其 Python 说明仅适用于 replay。

支持原 VeriScope 归档，以及 B2 的 GateArchiveV1 和指定 Ragas records 布局。不支持的格式明确拒绝，不猜测或换算。

## 已有评分直接用：B2（0.6.0 本地候选）

已经用 Ragas 得到了评分？导出评分 JSON，写明要检查的指标和阈值，让插件执行门禁并保存回执。**无需安装 VeriScope，也不会重新调用模型评分。**

只需 Node ≥22.19，在宿主启动前显式设置 `VERISCOPE_STATE_DIR` 为可写持久目录。没有 settings UI，不读取 `.env`。B2 不使用 VeriScope／Python 路径。

> 使用 `veriscope_gate_check` 检查 `D:\data\scores.json`，策略为 `D:\data\policy.json`，格式为 `ragas-records-v1`，告诉我是否通过和原因。

源码可直接试构造样例：

```powershell
$env:VERISCOPE_STATE_DIR = 'D:\your-data\veriscope-state'
node scripts/check.mjs --archive examples/builtin/ragas-records.json --policy examples/builtin/policy.json --format ragas-records-v1 --json
```

- 支持 `GateArchiveV1` 和 Ragas `result.to_pandas().to_json(orient="records")` 布局；策略显式选择 `GatePolicyV1` 或 `GatePolicyV2`，不猜测字段或阈值。
- 对全部输入记录算等权均值；缺失值不补零、不跳过。完整均值不达标，或已知有效行违反显式逐条阈值，为 FAIL；其余缺证据为 REVIEW，全部完整达标才 PASS。
- 不把 `faithfulness` 改成 `pos_faithfulness`；B2 的 PASS 不等同原门禁，不证明评分或回答事实正确，也不检查导出前被删掉的记录。
- DSH／MCP 都提供 check；CLI 安装后的命令为 `veriscope-check`。`doctor({engine:"builtin"})` 不探测 Python；status／list 支持两种回执。
- B2 使用 ReceiptV2，首版只有文本，不接入 bind／complete；DSH 导出支持 JSON／Markdown，B2 暂不支持 share。回执仍无限保留，不自动清理。

**均值通过，仍可看到最差一条。** 每指标显示最差有效行及未达均值阈值的条数；诊断本身不改裁决。需要逐条拦截时，用 `GatePolicyV2` 加 `row_threshold`，沿用该指标的方向和单位。例如构造分数的均值为 0.81、其中一条为 0.41：只查均值可 PASS，显式要求每条 ≥0.5 才 FAIL。V2 使用 JSON 原数字词元作精确十进制比较；V1 原浮点判定保持不变。

规范、策略和导出方式见包内 `docs/B2.md`、`schemas/`、`examples/builtin/`。样例为文档构造，非真实评测。0.6.0 已发布至 npm；Windows 与 Ubuntu 远端 CI（含固定上游真实回放）均已验证，Claude 完整结构化错误交付仍待验。0.5.0 历史验收保留在 `docs/acceptance-b2-v0.5.0.json`。

## 原 VeriScope 路径：配置后上手

配置好环境后（见下一节），在 DSH 中依次输入：

1. “使用 `veriscope_doctor` 检查本机环境，告诉我需要修复什么。”
2. “使用 VeriScope 检查 `D:\数据\评测结果.json`，说明是否通过及原因。”
3. “使用 `veriscope_gate_list` 列出最近的门禁回执与当前有效性。”

之后还可以说：

> 检查上次的门禁结果现在是否仍然有效。

体检的“环境就绪”仅表示环境可用，门禁通过需实际重放。聊天能否自动选中工具取决于 DSH 的模型配置；需要时直接写出工具名。

三个常见的小场景：

- **想发给维护者**：“把这次门禁失败整理成可分享的求助摘要。”使用 `format: "share"` 生成本地 Markdown，先预览、再自行分享；不是回执。
- **归档打不开**：重放会在能确认时给出异常行列或字段位置，帮助定位；不会自动改文件。
- **昨天通过、今天待复核**：状态检查会列出已确认的阈值、版本、输入摘要等变化；无法核实的范围明确保留。

需要约束任务完成时，可以要求绑定本次检查；只有绑定的回执当前有效且为 PASS，才能登记完成。

**使用前请配置 VeriScope 与 Python 路径；插件不会重新调用评测模型。**

## 安装与配置

本文对应 **0.6.0 本地候选**，提供 DSH 插件和独立的 `veriscope-mcp` 入口。npm 可用版本以[包页面](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-veriscope)为准；MCP 配置与待验范围见下文。在已验证的 DSH CLI 中，需显式指定 profile；以下使用独立的 `veriscope-demo`：

```powershell
# 安装
dsh plugin --profile veriscope-demo add dsh-plugin-veriscope
# 查看已安装版本
dsh plugin --profile veriscope-demo list dsh-plugin-veriscope --depth 0
# 卸载
dsh plugin --profile veriscope-demo remove dsh-plugin-veriscope
```

二次开发可走**本地目录安装**，与 npm 包名安装分开：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile veriscope-demo add 'D:\your-workspace\dsh-plugin-veriscope'
```

以上目录路径须替换为源码实际位置；不要将目录／link 安装结果当成 registry 安装证明。**安装成功不等于门禁通过**，原 replay 首次使用需配置 `VERISCOPE_ROOT` 与 `VERISCOPE_PYTHON` 并运行体检；只用 B2 则仅配置状态根。npm 包不含测试；同包包含 `docs/B2.md`、格式规范和 B2 样例，其余文档见仓库；`npm test` 仅供源码开发；`node scripts/verify-replay.mjs` 也仅在完整源码仓库及其验证材料就绪时可用，不属于安装包能力。完整文档请查看仓库。

0.3.x 历史已验证：Windows、DSH NEXT 2.0.18-next，内部 DSH／tools／skill **0.2.1-alpha.2**。Node ≥22.19；其他宿主版本未验证。另需兼容上游及 Python／pandas，固定依赖见 [上游说明](https://github.com/4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope/blob/main/docs/UPSTREAM.md)。插件不附送完整上游或业务归档。

DSH 入口要求 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 为 `0.2.1-alpha.2`，加载前核对版本，加载后检查 `defineTool`。缺失、不兼容、加载失败分别报 `SDK_MISSING`、`SDK_INCOMPATIBLE`、`SDK_LOAD_FAILED`，不会自动安装或切换版本；这些检查不代替宿主验收。MCP 不加载 DSH SDK。

### 配置项

**没有 settings UI，不自动读取 `.env`。** 路径只读宿主进程环境变量；cordis patch 只接受 `completionMode`。宿主自己的环境加载策略由宿主决定。

| 配置 | 入口 | 默认值与要求 |
|---|---|---|
| `veriscopeRoot` | `VERISCOPE_ROOT` | Windows 默认 `D:\RAG_Evaluation_Demo`；POSIX 必须显式设置 |
| `pythonPath` | `VERISCOPE_PYTHON` | 依次探测 `.venv`／`venv`：Windows 为 `Scripts/python.exe`，POSIX 为 `bin/python`；不回退 PATH |
| 状态根 | `VERISCOPE_STATE_DIR` | 原 DSH replay 默认 `<插件目录>/.local`；B2 和所有 MCP 工具必须显式设置持久目录 |
| 提醒模式 | cordis patch `completionMode` | `off`；只允许 `off` 或 `remind`，非法值报错 |

三个环境变量的显式值须为非空绝对路径，无效值不静默回退。在**启动 DSH 的同一终端**设置后启动或完全重启宿主：

```powershell
$env:VERISCOPE_ROOT = 'D:\your-workspace\VeriScope'
$env:VERISCOPE_PYTHON = 'D:\your-workspace\VeriScope\venv\Scripts\python.exe'
$env:VERISCOPE_STATE_DIR = 'D:\your-data\veriscope-state'
# 若从 GitHub 安装，可用此命令替代前文的 npm 安装命令
dsh plugin --profile veriscope-demo add github:4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope
```

先准备独立 profile 和对应宿主 CLI；安装命令不创建完整宿主配置。插件 bundle 已插入默认条目；在 `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/<名称>/cordis.patch.yml` 按已有 `id` 覆盖配置，不要再次 `insert`：

```yaml
- id: dsh-plugin-veriscope
  config:
    completionMode: "remind"
```

`off` 关闭停止事件提醒，全部工具仍可使用。`remind` 只提醒未完成的绑定任务，不承诺普通聊天全局阻断。路径不能写入这个 config。

## 跨宿主 MCP

MCP 仍为五个工具；V2 策略复用 check／status／list，不增加入口。0.5.0 历史实调用与未验范围见 `docs/acceptance-b2-v0.5.0.json`，不替代本候选验证。以下仅回顾 0.4.0 历史验收。

0.4.0 已在独立 Claude Code／Codex 宿主通过真实工具调用（控制接口，无模型对话），Windows 与 Ubuntu 真实回放均已验证。Claude 错误路径只返回文本，完整结构化交付仍有待验项，详见验收记录。使用绝对 Node 路径启动源码 `mcp.js`，配置及独立环境示例见 [MCP 接入说明](https://github.com/4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope/blob/main/docs/MCP.md)。无需加载 DSH SDK。首版只有 `veriscope_doctor`、`veriscope_gate_replay`、`veriscope_gate_status`、`veriscope_gate_list` 四工具，无原生卡片。batch／export 及 bind／complete 仍只在 DSH；会话绑定不会移植，MCP 报告的 `execution.session_id` 为 `null`。

当前 MCP 五工具都要求显式、合法的 `VERISCOPE_STATE_DIR`；未设置时返回待复核，不回退包目录。doctor 会写入并清理临时探针，replay 会写报告和回执，二者及新增 check 不是只读；status／list 为只读。业务 FAIL 不等于工具执行错误。宿主工具调用、Linux 真实回放及本版本验收状态以 [验收记录](https://github.com/4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope/blob/main/docs/acceptance-mcp-v0.4.0.json) 为准；注册成功或自写客户端通过不能替代宿主验收。

## 九个工具

| 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `veriscope_gate_check({archive_path, policy_path, format?})` | Node 独立阈值判定；消费已有逐条评分，生成 ReceiptV2，不需要 Python |
| `veriscope_doctor({engine?})` | 默认检查原 replay 环境；`engine:"builtin"` 只检查 Node 和显式状态根，附修复建议 |
| `veriscope_gate_replay({result_path, baseline?, faith?, ctx?})` | 实际执行已有归档门禁，保存独立记录，符合条件时生成 ReceiptV1 |
| `veriscope_gate_status({run_id, faith?, ctx?, baseline_run_id?})` | 只读检查回执当前有效性，不重放、不评分、不生成回执 |
| `veriscope_gate_list({limit?})` | 默认列出最近 50 条，允许 1–200；逐条复用 status，损坏记录另列 |
| `veriscope_gate_batch({paths?, dir?, baseline?, faith?, ctx?})` | 路径数组与目录二选一；顺序重放，最多 200 份，可取消，逐份留痕 |
| `veriscope_gate_export({run_id?, run_ids?, format})` | 导出 1–50 条记录到状态根 `exports/`；`share` 为白名单求助摘要，`md` 为完整报告，`json` 为原回执；不覆盖旧文件 |
| `veriscope_gate_bind({task_id, run_id, faith?, ctx?, baseline_run_id?})` | 在宿主提供的本会话内绑定受管任务与当前回执 |
| `veriscope_gate_complete({task_id, run_id})` | 复验本会话绑定，只在当前有效 PASS 下登记完成 |

### 参数与使用规则

- 原 replay 阈值默认 0.8，须为 0–1 有限数值，不为获得 PASS 自动调低。

plugins.description: 功能：可选择会话中的语句，代码段进行标记
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-code-marks

[![test](https://github.com/petex7238/DSH-Tag-Plugin/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/petex7238/DSH-Tag-Plugin/actions/workflows/test.yml)

> Select code or a sentence in a DeepSeek Harness conversation, tag it, and jump back to **that exact line** later — from a rail of deep-blue bars on the conversation's right edge, or from a right-sidebar tab. Marks live outside the transcript, so the next twenty follow-up questions cannot push them away.

在 DSH 对话里**选中一段代码或一句话 → 打个标签**，它就固定下来：对话左边缘长出一根深蓝短条，右侧栏的「标记」页签里也有一条记录。点任意一处，那段原文**瞬时**跳到**可视区正中间**、闪一下并选中。

解决的是这件事：追问一多，正确题解就被顶上去，回看要翻很久。标记存在对话流之外，所以**永远顶不掉**。

- 标注对象：助手回答里的代码段与文字（跨行选也支持）
- 标签自定义：可新建 / 改名 / 换色 / 删除，6 种颜色
- 跳转精确到**字符**，不是"大约回到那条消息"
- 不上传、不同步、不进会话日志：全部存在本机 `localStorage`

## 装上

需要 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 或更新（桌面端或 `dsh web`）。

装的是"插件组合包"，所以 DSH 只认 **安装 spec**（不是搜索词）。在桌面端走：侧栏 **插件** → 安装 → 粘贴下面任一 spec；或者用 CLI `dsh plugin --profile desktop add "<spec>"`。**装完不用重启，刷新一次页面即可。**

### 一 · 从 GitHub 装（不需要 npm 账号）

三种写法，效果一样，按你的网络和工具选：

```bash
# 1) git 协议（pnpm 会浅克隆）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "github:petex7238/DSH-Tag-Plugin#main"

# 2) tarball 直链（没有 git 也能装，https 一次下载）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "https://github.com/petex7238/DSH-Tag-Plugin/archive/refs/heads/main.tar.gz"

# 3) 下载 ZIP → 解压 → 用本地路径装
#    浏览器打开仓库 → 绿色 Code 按钮 → Download ZIP → 解压到任意目录
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "D:/tools/DSH-Tag-Plugin"
```

三点提醒：

- **网络**：GitHub 装法要能访问 github.com。国内环境下 git 协议还需要给 git 配代理（`git config --global http.proxy http://127.0.0.1:7890`），tarball 直链走的是 https，通常更容易通。
- **固定版本**：把 `#main` 换成 `#<commit sha>` 或 `#v0.1.0` 就不会被后续改动带着跑。
- **更新**：`github:` / tarball 装的不会自动升级，重新执行一次安装命令即可（同一包名会覆盖）。

### 二 · 从 npm 装（发布后可用）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-code-marks
```

或在插件页填 `dsh-code-marks`。npm 的版本号即包版本，升级同样重装一次。

### 三 · 本地路径（改代码 / 开发）

```bash
git clone https://github.com/petex7238/DSH-Tag-Plugin.git
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "/absolute/path/to/DSH-Tag-Plugin"
```

仓库目录会被 `link` 进 profile，改 `plugin/client.js` 会被客户端 HMR 直接热替换，不用重启 DSH。

### 装完怎么确认

右上/侧栏 **插件** 列表里出现 `dsh-code-marks` 且为启用状态；在对话里选中一段助手回答，左边缘会冒出一根深蓝短条。

## 怎么用

1. 在助手的回答里，用鼠标选中一段代码或一句话（也支持跨行选）。
2. 松手后浮出标签条，点一个标签（`核心逻辑 / 疑问 / 易错点 / 待复习`，或点 `＋` 现建一个）。
3. 松手处冒出一句「已标记「核心逻辑」」，1.5 秒后自己消失；对话左边缘的上部同时长出一根深蓝短条。

**不会自动打开右栏**——标记不该抢你的视线和焦点。确认只发生在原地，要跳回去就点左边那根条。

回到标记有两条路：对话左边缘的**深蓝短条**（不用开右栏，悬停看名称、点击跳转），或右栏「标记」页签里的条目——两者跳的是同一处。

面板关掉以后怎么找回来：右栏页签条的 **添加** 按钮 → 引导页 → 「标记」胶囊。

## 面板里能做什么

| 操作 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 点一条标记 | 跳回原文并居中（旧内容没加载时会自动点「加载更早」把历史拉回来，最多 16 次） |
| 悬停一条标记 | 在对话里临时高亮它（不跳转） |
| 名字（有就显示） | 标签旁边显示你给这条标记起的名字；起名在左边缘长条的右键菜单里 |
| 标签 chip 行 | 按标签筛选，括号里是该标签的条数 |
| 搜索框 | 按选中原文或备注过滤 |
| ✎ | 给这条标记写/改备注（比如「这里为什么要 -1」） |
| × | 删除这条标记 |
| ⚙ | 标签管理：新建、改名、换颜色、删除（删除标签时它的标记会转到第一个标签） |

高亮颜色跟着标签走，6 种颜色可选，深浅色主题都用同一套半透明底色。

## 左边缘的深蓝色短条

对话左边缘的上部会挂一排**深蓝色短条**，一条对应一个标记，从上到下就是对话里的先后顺序。它和 DSH 自己那条"轮次刻度"是同一套形状（20×2 圆角、10px 节距），但**放在左边**——轮次刻度占着右边缘，两条轨道互不遮挡，读起来仍是对话的一部分，不是外挂。

- **不用打开右栏**：鼠标挪过去就能用，点击直接跳到那段原文（该翻页会自己翻）。
- **悬停**：长条**右边**浮出小卡片（贴着左侧边缘，所以往右弹），显示标签名/名字、原文前几行、第几轮；同时对话里那一段会亮起来，方便确认是不是你要找的那条。
- **右键菜单**：在长条上点右键弹出小菜单——「跳转到这条标记」「重命名名称」「删除这条标记」。**右键本身不删任何东西**，误触只是弹个菜单；真删掉后还有 5 秒「撤销」兜底。键盘也通：Tab 聚焦长条后按 `Delete`/`Backspace`（同样有撤销）。
- **给标记起名**：菜单里选「重命名名称」，会就地变成一格输入框，回车保存、`Esc` 取消（留空则回到显示原文）。名字只属于这一条标记——标签（`核心逻辑` 等）是全组共用的，名字是你给它的备注标题。起了名字之后，悬停小卡片和右栏面板都优先显示名字。
- **不会打架**：长条只占对话列上部约 42% 的高度，标记多了在轨道内部滚动；右栏开合、窗口缩放时它会跟着对话列移动。
- 当前会话一条标记都没有时，整排长条不出现。

这两个浮层（框选后弹出的标签条、长条悬停出的小卡片）固定用 **`#232324` 深底 + 浅色字**，不跟随主题：深色浮层在浅色页面上更抓眼，浅色主题下也不会变成白底黑字看不清。文字对比度都在 4.5:1 以上（正文 7:1 以上）。

## 数据与隐私

都在这台机器的浏览器存储里（`localStorage`），不上传、不进会话日志、不产生任何网络请求：

- `dsh.code.marks.v2.<sessionId>`：这个会话的标记（原文、位置、标签、备注、时间）
- `dsh.code.marks.v1.tags`：标签表（全局共享，所有会话通用）

每个会话的标记互相独立；换会话就看那个会话的标记。清空：清站点数据，或删掉这两个 key。

插件本身**没有 Host 半侧逻辑**：`plugin/index.mjs` 是一个空 `apply()`，只为了让 DSH 有一个可加载的 Loader 条目、从而把浏览器半侧的 bundle 发出去。

## 它是怎么做到「跳得准」的

一条标记不存 DOM 节点（React 会重渲染、代码块会从 plain 换成高亮版、流式输出一直在追加），只存四样东西：

1. `data-chat-node-key` / `data-chat-anchor-key`：这条消息在对话里的身份（原样存，不解析）
2. 消息内文本偏移 + 选中的原文
3. 前后各 48 个字符的上下文
4. `data-chat-turn`：第几轮（兜底用）

解析时按四级降级：精确锚点 → 同 node 的行 → 精确原文 → 上下文打分（含「空白全部忽略」的兜底，所以重新缩进的代码也能认出来）。

高亮用 **CSS Custom Highlight API**（`CSS.highlights` + `::highlight()`），只建 Range 不改 DOM，所以不会被 React 的 diff 冲掉；对话变化时以 240ms 去抖重建 Range。

跳转是按"标记文本的 Range"算的，不是按消息行：一条长回答可以几千像素高，行居中会让人"跳过去却看不见"。落点对齐到对话可视带的中线（扣掉底部输入框占位），并且**瞬时**完成、不做滚动动画。

## 已知限制

- **折叠起来的过程组**里的文字选不到；要先展开它。标记落在被折叠的内容里时，点标记会尝试点开那个组，失败则提示「先往上滚一点」。
- 原文被改写（比如重新生成过这条回答）到认不出来的程度时，只能定位到这条消息，高亮位置对不上——面板会明确提示，不会瞎标。
- 跳转是程序化滚动，DSH 会认为「读者自己滚了」，于是暂停「跟随最新」；对话自己跳轮次也是这样。
- 只对**助手的回答**（`assistant-step`）开放标记；工具调用、终端输出暂不支持。
- 标记只存在本机浏览器，不跨设备同步；也没有导出/导入。

## 卸载

DSH 设置 → 插件 → 找到 `dsh-code-marks` → 停用或卸载。卸载后浏览器里的标记数据仍在，重装即回来。

## 开发

插件是**手写的浏览器 bundle**，没有构建步骤：`plugin/client.js` 就是一个 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 的经典脚本，DSH 的模块系统直接发它。

```bash
npm install          # 只为测试台装 puppeteer-core
npm test             # 108 项断言，headless Chrome
```

测试台 `tools/harness/` 用一份合成的对话 DOM 跑真实 Chromium，覆盖：锚定与四级降级、重复原文、代码块 plain→Shiki 换 DOM、流式追加、翻页、悬浮标签条、边缘长条（含右键菜单/重命名/撤销）、深色浮层对比度、跳转居中与瞬时落位、面板渲染。

- `CHROME_PATH` 可指定浏览器；否则自动找 Chrome/Edge/Chromium。
- 没有 `puppeteer-core` 时会退而使用 DSH profile 里已有的那一份（需要 `DSH_HOME` + `DSH_PROFILE`）。
- `设计说明.md` 记录了每个设计决策的理由与验证矩阵（中文）。

### 发布（维护者）

包名 `dsh-code-marks`，`publishConfig.access` 已是 `public`。两条路，选一条：

**A. 本机发**（需要先 `npm login`）：

```bash
npm publish
```

**B. 让 GitHub 代发**（本机网络/登录不顺时用这条）：

1. 在 npmjs.com 生成 **Automation** 类型 token（不会弹 OTP），权限 Read and write；
2. 仓库 → Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → 新建 secret `NPM_TOKEN`；
3. 发一个 GitHub Release，或手动跑 `publish` workflow。

`publish` workflow 会先 `npm pack --dry-run` 打印将发布的文件清单，再 `npm publish`；版本冲突时 npm 会直接报错。

发新版：`npm version patch`（或 minor/major）→ push → 再走上面任一方式。

## 许可

MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: C-137 Virus — a neon-green deep-space DSH skin
plugins.readme_text:
# C-137 Virus

> 荧光绿的深空病毒主题 —— 给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) 的 DSH 皮肤
>
> A neon-green deep-space virus theme for DeepSeek Harness.

![preview](preview/light.webp)

## 这是什么

一套完整的 DSH 皮肤：深空星空背景、双角色立绘、卡通风格的九宫格对话框外壳、黑底 + 荧光绿描边配色。

- **纯前端插件**：只改样式和 DOM 装饰，不注入服务、不碰模型请求
- **热切换**：装好刷新页面即生效，卸载即恢复，不需要重启
- **跟随聊天框**：左右立绘各自锚定输入框的左右边缘，窗口变宽变窄都不会跑偏
- **九宫格外壳**：输入框皮肤用 `border-image` 实现，四角不拉伸、四边自适应

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的profile> add dsh-skin-c137-virus
```

装完**刷新页面**（Ctrl+Shift+R）即可，然后在「设置 → 皮肤管理」里切换。

> 皮肤之间是互斥的，同时启用多套会被管理器回退成官方默认。

## 功能

| 功能    | 说明                                      |
| ----- | --------------------------------------- |
| 深空背景  | 亮/暗两套背景，随主题自动切换                         |
| 双角色立绘 | 左高右矮（比例 1.63:1）· 自动贴聊天框 · 底部留白不压输入框     |
| 对话框外壳 | 九宫格 `border-image` · 12px 1:1 渲染 · 切缝对齐 |
| 荧光绿光标 | `#bafa78`，深色输入区里清晰可见                    |
| 配色系统  | 黑底 + 荧光绿，代码块深底、行内代码浅底深字                 |
| 窗口适配  | 立绘高度用百分比 · 拥挤时自动隐藏一侧 · 锚点随布局实时重算        |

## 自定义

皮肤素材走 `artwork/` → `tools/apply-artwork.py` 的流程：

```sh
python tools/apply-artwork.py --dry-run   # 看它打算做什么
python tools/apply-artwork.py             # 执行：转格式、算哈希、重写引用
python tools/verify-skin.py               # 自检 20 项
```

槽位清单与尺寸见 [`artwork/README.md`](artwork/README.md)。

## 许可

- **代码**：MIT（见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)）
- **美术**：见 [NOTICE](NOTICE) 与 [LICENSE-ARTWORK](LICENSE-ARTWORK)

## 免责

非官方项目，与 DeepSeek 官方无关。皮肤美术资源的使用请自行确认授权范围。

plugins.description: Miran Fann for DeepSeek Harness: motion-graphics tools, a Miran settings page and DeepSeek motion skills. Needs the Miran Fann engine (npx miran-fann setup).
plugins.readme_text: # Miran Fann for DeepSeek Harness Motion graphics on this Mac, from a dsh session. The plugin starts the Miran engine, hands its tools to the model as `mcp__miran__*`, and adds a **Miran** section to dsh Settings. ```text dsh session ──tool call──► dsh mcp-client ──stdio──► ~/.miran/bin/miran mcp ▲ │ └────────────── frame, video, project JSON ◄───────────┘ ``` ## Install The engine comes first; the plugin only connects to it. ```sh npx miran-fann setup # the engine in ~/.miran/bin/miran ``` Setup adds the plugin to the `web` profile by itself when dsh is installed, and every automatic update of the engine brings the plugin of the same version. To add it by hand, use **Plugins** in the dsh web sidebar with the address below, or: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:rakibulrocky14/miran-fann-dsh#v0.1.6 ``` dsh 0.2.1-rc.2 or newer is needed (`npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@next`). Restart `dsh web` after the install. `dsh --profile web --dump-config` shows the `miran-fann` layer when it loaded. ## Sign in Miran's tools run only for a signed-in install. Open **Settings → Miran**: the page shows the account, the engine version, the GPU backend and whether the tools are connected. **Sign in** runs the real flow (the browser opens miranfann.com, the engine receives the code); **Sign out** ends it. The plugin never fakes the sign-in and never works around it. ## Settings Everything on **Settings → Miran** is read from and written to the engine, so dsh, Claude Code and Codex agree: | Part | What it does | | --- | --- | | Account | Who is signed in; sign in and out through the engine | | Engine | Path, version, GPU, setup command when missing | | Workspace | Folder the engine reads and writes | | Tools | Tool surface (default, lean, full); the engine's own choice | | dsh tools | Connected state, reconnect | | Live viewer | Start the viewer, viewer theme, time units, preview quality | | Render defaults | Export quality, file-size limit, default voice | | API keys | Google Gemini, ElevenLabs, OpenRouter, fal, Replicate | | Generation | Image, video and draft models, per-call and per-day caps, spend so far | | Voices | Default voice, cloud voices, built-in voice | | Feedback and updates | Share feedback, auto-update, version, update now | | Skills | The skills this plugin gives the agent | Keys go to dsh's credential store **and** to Miran's own key store, as secret fields. The page only ever shows the last four characters. An environment variable with the same name wins over both. The **Built-in plugins → Miran** tab shows the same state as a card, with **Open live viewer**. ## Tools and skills The model sees the engine's tools as `mcp__miran__`. The default list is the engine's own `MIRAN_TOOLS_DEFAULT`; **Settings → Tools** offers the engine choice, `lean` (about 30 tools, the rest through `runScript`) and `full` (every tool in the schema). Skills ship in `skills//SKILL.md` and load into dsh's skill registry, so `/miran-...` and model-side loading use the same files. Start with `miran-dsh-studio`; it names the others. | Skill | Teaches | | --- | --- | | `miran-dsh-studio` | The order of work, research, the beat sheet, the handoff map | | `miran-dsh-directions` | Choosing a visual direction per brief, never a house look | | `miran-dsh-reference` | Studying reference videos and turning them into the film's own timing and motion | | `miran-dsh-shots` | What goes on screen: planes, keeping a beat alive | | `miran-dsh-design` | Hierarchy, readable sizes, depth, real UI | | `miran-dsh-type` | Setting, revealing and reading type | | `miran-dsh-motion` | Eases, timing, holds, the motion library | | `miran-dsh-cuts` | Shot length, cutting, transitions | | `miran-dsh-camera` | Depth, pushes, 3D screens, rack focus | | `miran-dsh-sound` | Music, events, levels, the drop | | `miran-dsh-polish` | Finishing, grade, export, captions | | `miran-dsh-launch` | The arc of a launch film | | `miran-dsh-explainer` | The structure of an explainer | | `miran-dsh-social` | 9:16, hooks, captions, loops | ## Configuration Profile settings live in `cordis.patch.yml`; every field has a default. | Field | Default | Meaning | | --- | --- | --- | | `enginePath` | `""` | Engine binary; empty means `~/.miran/bin/miran`, then `PATH` (`MIRAN_BINARY` also counts) | | `workspace` | `""` | Folder the engine reads and writes; empty leaves it to the engine | | `tools` | `"default"` | `default` follows `MIRAN_TOOLS_DEFAULT`, `lean` lists about 30 tools, `full` lists all | | `viewer` | `true` | Start the live viewer with the engine | | `viewerPort` | `47800` | Preferred viewer port; the next free one when taken | ## Troubleshooting **"Miran engine not found"** — run `npx miran-fann setup`, or set `enginePath` to the binary. The settings page prints the path it looked for. **Tools connected, but a call says sign-in is required** — open **Settings → Miran** and sign in; the engine gates every tool call on the account. **No Miran section in Settings** — the browser half did not load. Check that `dsh --profile --dump-config` lists `miran-fann`, then restart `dsh web` and reload the page. **A render returns no image** — the engine sends images as MCP image parts; dsh shows them in the session. If a call returns text only, the engine refused the render and the message says why. **The viewer will not open** — the port is taken. Change `viewerPort`, or stop the other viewer.

plugins.description: A permanent 'Delete session' action for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, behind a confirmation dialog.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-clean-delete

A permanent **Delete session** action for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, behind a
confirmation dialog that tells you what is about to go.

DSH ships a *Archive* action, which is reversible and keeps the session in the
Archived list. This plugin adds the irreversible counterpart, and — unlike a
naive `rm` of the session log — it actually makes the row disappear.

![The session menu in the sidebar, with the Delete session row below Archive](docs/session-menu.png)

## What it does

Adds one row to the per-session `…` menu in the left sidebar, ordered after
Pin / Rename / Fork / Archive. Choosing it opens a modal that reports:

- whether the session is **still open on this machine** (it cannot be reopened afterwards),
- the **log size** about to be removed,
- **running turns, subagents, background jobs and reminders** bound to the session,
- how many reminders are deleted with it.

![The confirmation dialog, reporting the log size and the session's live activity](docs/delete-confirm-dialog.png)

Confirming stops the session's work, unlinks its session directory and projection
checkpoint, and releases the id from every registry that would otherwise keep
listing it. Then the sidebar refreshes and the row is gone.

There is **no undo and no trash folder**. The dialog says so.

## Why it is not just `rm`

A session's directory is not the only thing that makes it appear. The Host's
session corpus is `persistence ∪ live`, so a session the Host still holds live
keeps coming back after its log is deleted:

1. the browser drops the row,
2. the next `sessions.refresh()` rebuilds the rows from the Host list and folds
   the live summary back in,
3. the row **returns**.

The visible symptom of this is that deleting several sessions in a row makes the
earlier ones reappear, and that archived rows come back stuck in Archived forever
(the old id was never removed from the archive set, so it accumulated dead ids).

`release()` therefore detaches through the same teardown the owning fiber uses,
in the order the agent loop's own disposal uses — **agents first, then
sessions** — plus `unarchiveSession(id)` and `workspace.detachSession(id)`. The
browser keeps its own `retired` set and re-applies every retirement after each
refresh, so rows stay retired until the Host's `api-session/removed` agrees.

## Install

This package ships a `dsh.bundle` manifest, so `dsh plugin` installs it as a
profile layer by itself — **you do not need to edit `cordis.patch.yml`**. Bare
`@deepseek-ai/*` imports are resolved by the host itself, so the package declares
**zero dependencies** — do not add them.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-session-clean-delete
```

That is the npm name, and it is also the repository name.

From a source clone, `dsh plugin` is a pnpm passthrough, so a `file:` path works
too:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/path/to/dsh-session-clean-delete
```

That command does two things: it adds the package as a dependency, **and** it
appends it to `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile's `package.json`. The second
half is the one people miss — without it the package is just an unused
dependency, because the bundle patch in [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml)
is only read for packages the bundle list names.

Verify it joined the tree — the entry must appear under a banner naming the
plugin's own `cordis.patch.yml`, which is the part that is easy to miss:

```bash
dsh --profile <profile> --dump-config | grep -B1 session-clean-delete
```

```
# == …/dsh-session-clean-delete/cordis.patch.yml
- id: session-clean-delete
  name: dsh-session-clean-delete
```

A row under a banner for the *profile's* `cordis.patch.yml` means something
inserted this plugin by hand and it is **not** installed as a bundle — the
dependency is present but the layer never composes. `--dump-config` never
mounts, so it is safe against the live profile.

Finally **restart the harness**. The bundle is composed at boot, so there is no
partial effect: until it restarts, the menu row is not there.

### If nothing happens

- **Re-running the same add is a no-op** — same spec, same version.
  `rm -rf ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-session-clean-delete` first, or
  the profile keeps serving the old copy forever.
- pnpm **copies** the package into the profile rather than symlinking it, so
  editing your clone does not change the running plugin. Copy
  `lib/*.js` into `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-session-clean-delete/lib/`.
  `client.js` hot-reloads; `index.js` is host-side and needs a restart.
- `dsh plugin` needs `pnpm` on `PATH` (`corepack enable pnpm`), or it fails with
  "pnpm was not found".
- pnpm installs a version **older** than the registry `latest` when a release is
  less than 24 h old — that is `minimumReleaseAge`, a supply-chain guardrail, not
  a stale cache. Wait, or use a `^x.y.z` range so the newer release arrives on
  its own.

## Design notes

**A Typert `Remote` service, not an HTTP route.** The host half registers one
`TypertRemoteService` named `sessionDelete` with `describe` and `deleteSession`.
The Gateway auto-claims every endpoint a live `TypertRemoteService` declares, and
the browser calls it over the ordinary channel:

```js
ctx.connection.rpc.call('/api', `sessionDelete/${method}`, { args: { request } })
```

So there is no route to register and no permission to grant — the browser peer is
the owner principal.

**It deliberately does not check `Origin`.** In the desktop app the renderer
origin is the custom scheme `dsh-app://app`, and the shell's `protocol.handle`
strips `origin`, `host`, `cookie` and `sec-fetch-site` before forwarding to the
Host. A plugin route that validates `origin === 'http://' + host` therefore 403s
*every* request from the desktop app while working fine under `dsh web`. The
Remote-service path avoids the question entirely.

**The postcondition is checked against the disk.** A successful `rm` is not
treated as proof; `removeLog()` stats the path afterwards and throws
`delete/failed` if it survived.

## Localization

The screenshots above show the **Simplified Chinese** UI. The plugin ships
Simplified Chinese (`zh`) and English (`en`) dictionaries with identical key
sets, and the strings follow the app's language setting automatically — there is
nothing to configure.

Traditional Chinese is **not** part of this package. It comes from the separate
[`dsh-zh-hant`](https://github.com/wilsonchengassistant/dsh-zh-hant) language
pack, which owns the `zh-Hant` locale for the whole app and derives it
mechanically from every plugin's `zh` table. Install it and the dialog above
reads 永久删除会话？; without it you get the Simplified Chinese version, which is
the expected behaviour rather than a bug.

## Files

| Path | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `lib/index.js` | Host half: `TypertRemoteService`, the delete sequence, registry release. |
| `lib/client.js` | Browser half: the menu row and the `shell.overlay` confirmation dialog. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch named by `dsh.bundle`; inserts this plugin into a profile. |
| `locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.json` | Plugin titles for the Plugins panel. |
| `docs/*.png` | Screenshots used by this README and by `screenshots.json`. |

The in-app dictionary lives in `lib/client.js` (`zh` is the key-set source of
truth, `en` is checked complete against it); `locale/*.json` is the metadata the
Plugins panel reads.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: Host CPU / memory rings under the DeepSeek Harness composer, with a one-minute trend panel on click.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-sysmon

在 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（dsh）输入卡片正下方显示本机 **CPU / 内存** 的圆环水位，点一下展开一分钟走势与明细。

English | [中文](#中文)

```text
… 费用明细 本会话 ¥0.5181 · 命中 98.8% │ CPU ◔ 26% │ 内存 ◕ 56% │ ◯ 28%
                                       └── 本插件 ──┘
```

![行内圆环](docs/preview-inline.png)

![点开面板](docs/preview-panel.png)

## 中文

### 功能

- **行内**：`CPU ◔ 26%` + `内存 ◕ 56%` 两个小圆环 + 百分比。圆环几何照抄宿主自带的上下文用量圆圈
  （ContextMeter）：14px 视框、半径 5.5、2px 描边、底环 `--dsw-alias-border-l3`、从 -90° 顺时针画。
- **警示**：正常走中性色，≥75% 转黄（`--dsw-alias-state-warn-primary`）、≥90% 转红（`--dsw-alias-state-error-primary`），环和数字一起变色。
- **点开**：面板里给 CPU / 内存各一条一分钟走势（带 50% 虚线参考线），外加核数与 CPU 型号、
  内存已用/总量、磁盘占用、DSH 进程常驻内存、开机时长。点面板外面或按 Esc 收起。
- **省电**：前台每 2s 取一次数，标签页隐藏降到 15s，连续失败退避到 10s；采样在宿主侧按 1s 走。
- **双语**：文案跟随 DSH 界面语言（中/英），取不到语言服务时中文兜底。
- **零依赖**：只有 `node:os` / `node:fs`，不装任何第三方包，不起子进程。

### 安装

从 GitHub 直接装（`web` 换成你的 profile 名）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:hehf21/dsh-sysmon
```

装完**刷新页面**。卸载：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-sysmon
```

桌面版（Electron）的 profile 由应用独占，CLI 装不了——改在侧栏 **插件** 页里安装/启用/停用。

注意：浏览器半边改动关一下插件再开就重新组合、刷新即见；宿主半边（`index.js`）是进程内 ESM 模块，
改了必须**重启 dsh** 才换代。

### 实现

```text
浏览器 client.js                        宿主进程 index.js
┌─────────────────────┐    GET      ┌──────────────────────────────┐
│ conversation        │ ──────────► │ /sysmon/stats（精确路由）      │
│ .composer.dock      │ ◄────────── │  ├ node:os  cpus() 时间片差    │
│ 两个圆环 + 点开面板  │    JSON     │  ├ node:os  totalmem/freemem  │
└─────────────────────┘             │  ├ node:fs  statfs 磁盘        │
                                    │  └ 1s 采样 → 60 格走势窗口     │
                                    └──────────────────────────────┘
```

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | 宿主半边：1s 采样 CPU 时间片差、内存占用、每 15s 采一次磁盘，维护 60 格走势窗口，注册 `GET /sysmon/stats`。 |
| `client.js` | 浏览器半边：`window.__ModuleLoader__.load` 注册工厂，`ctx.slots.inject('conversation.composer.dock', …)` 挂条目，轮询渲染。 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 插入宿主插件行 `sysmon`；行 id 决定浏览器半边的加载地址 `/plugins/sysmon/client.js`。 |

### 取值口径

- **CPU**：两次 `os.cpus()` 累计时间片之差，`1 - idleΔ/totalΔ`，跨全部核心加权；采样间隔内没有新时间片时保留上一次读数，避免曲线出现假谷底。
- **内存**：`(totalmem - freemem) / totalmem`。Windows 上 `freemem` 是「可用」内存，与任务管理器「使用中」同口径。
- **磁盘**：`fs.promises.statfs(<用户主目录所在盘>)`，Windows 上即 `C:\`；读取失败时该行不显示。
- 走势窗口是宿主侧的 60 格（约一分钟），客户端只读不算。

### 边界

- 只在**会话视图**渲染：`conversation.composer.dock` 的渲染条件是会话已存在，欢迎页（新会话空态）不显示。
- `/sysmon/stats` 不在 `/api` 前缀下，因此不走连接插件的浏览器信任栅栏：**能打开本机页面的本机进程**都能读到
  这几个数字（CPU/内存/磁盘占用率，无敏感信息）。dsh 桌面版只绑 `127.0.0.1`；如需收紧，在 `index.js`
  的 `handle()` 里加 Host / Origin 白名单。
- 无配置项。采样与轮询间隔是源码常量：宿主 `SAMPLE_MS`、客户端 `POLL_MS`。

### 与同类插件

同类开源实现另有 [hnmrxz/dsh-plugin-sysmon](https://github.com/hnmrxz/dsh-plugin-sysmon)（同槽位的状态胶囊）、
[AKS1st/dsh-sysmon](https://github.com/AKS1st/dsh-sysmon)（右下角悬浮窗）、
[Small-Miao/dsh-statusbar](https://github.com/Small-Miao/dsh-statusbar)（`shell.overlay` 整条底栏）。
本插件的磁盘 / 点击刷新 / 双语思路参考了第一个。

## English

Host CPU / memory rings under the dsh composer, with a one-minute trend panel on click.

- **Inline**: two 14px rings (same geometry as dsh's own context meter) plus percentages; amber at ≥75%, red at ≥90%.
- **On click**: a panel with a one-minute trend line per metric (dashed 50% reference), core count and CPU model,
  memory used/total, disk usage, the dsh process RSS, and host uptime.
- **Cost-aware**: 2 s polling in the foreground, 15 s while hidden, 10 s back-off after repeated failures;
  sampling happens host-side at 1 s.
- **Zero dependencies**: `node:os` / `node:fs` only — no third-party packages, no subprocesses.

Install (replace `web` with your profile name):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:hehf21/dsh-sysmon
```

Then refresh the page. The Electron desktop profile is managed by the app, so install it from the sidebar
**Plugins** page instead. Client-half changes reload by toggling the plugin; host-half changes need a dsh restart
(the host module is an in-process ES module cached by URL).

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Read Bilibili and Douyin from inside DeepSeek Harness: paced signed Bilibili API reads plus Douyin pages rendered through a real Edge browser over CDP.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-whale-dive

Read **Bilibili** and **Douyin** from inside [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh): nine model-facing tools, two very different transport problems, one read-only surface.

```
whale_dive_status            pacer health, cool-downs, cookie presence, WBI key age
whale_dive_bili_video        one video: metadata, parts, uploader, counters
whale_dive_bili_feed         the popular board, or one video's related rail
whale_dive_bili_search       keyword search: video / user / article / bangumi
whale_dive_bili_author       uploader profile plus a page of their uploads
whale_dive_bili_comments     a comment page with each thread's top replies
whale_dive_bili_danmaku      the danmaku track of one part
whale_dive_bili_subtitles    subtitle tracks per part, bodies when a cookie allows
whale_dive_douyin            hot / feed / video / search / status / close
```

## Why two transports

**Bilibili** answers plain HTTPS — but it signs its newer routes with a rotating `w_rid` (the "WBI" scheme) and it answers a sustained burst with an **IP-scoped HTTP 412 that outlives the burst by minutes**. Measured on one machine: 20 threads × 10 requests passed cleanly; 8 threads of mixed `view`+`search`+`reply` for 30 seconds (≈51 req/s) produced 1372 × HTTP 412 out of 2128 requests, and the block was still in force 90 seconds later. So the plugin ships a pacing layer rather than a bare `fetch`: a token bucket keyed per host, a concurrency cap, and a circuit breaker whose cool-down doubles on each consecutive trip.

The same measurement run also showed which routes survive without a signature, so the plugin prefers those and keeps the signed route as the fallback:

| Route | Signed? | Read by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x/web-interface/view` | no | `bili_video` |
| `x/web-interface/popular` | no | `bili_feed` (popular) |
| `x/web-interface/related` | no | `bili_feed` (related) |
| `x/v2/reply` | no | `bili_comments` |
| `x/player/v2` | no | `bili_subtitles` |
| `x/v1/dm/list.so` | no | `bili_danmaku` |
| `x/web-interface/card` | no | `bili_author` (profile) |
| `x/relation/stat` | no | `bili_author` (counts) |
| `x/series/recArchivesByKeywords` | no | `bili_author` (uploads, default order) |
| `x/web-interface/wbi/search/type` | WBI | `bili_search` |
| `x/space/wbi/arc/search` | WBI | `bili_author` (uploads, explicit order) |

**Douyin** cannot be read over HTTP at all. Its API calls carry `a_bogus`, `X-Bogus` and `__ac_signature`, all computed at runtime inside an obfuscated VM, and a plain client gets 403s, empty bodies, or a captcha interstitial. Headless browsers get the captcha too. The only route that works is a real, headful Edge/Chrome whose page computes its own signatures — so `whale_dive_douyin` launches one in its own profile directory, drives it over the Chrome DevTools Protocol, and reads the rendered DOM.

That path costs several seconds per call, and one detail is not obvious: a window parked off-screen is treated by Chromium as occluded, and an occluded window stops painting — the feed never hydrates and the DOM stays empty. The launcher therefore passes `--disable-backgrounding-occluded-windows`, `--disable-renderer-backgrounding` and `--disable-background-timer-throttling`, which is what makes the parked window actually render.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-whale-dive
```

The package ships its own `cordis.patch.yml`, so the loader row is inserted for you. Nothing else in the composition is touched: no base row config is replaced, no search provider is registered, so this patch cannot collide with another plugin that selects a provider.

Restart DSH after installing — profile changes are picked up at startup.

## Configuration

All fields live under the plugin's settings section and are read on every tool call, so an edit applies to the next call without a reload.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `requestsPerSecond` | `4` | Per-host request rate. The measured safe band is 5–10 req/s; 4 leaves headroom. |
| `burst` | `8` | Token-bucket capacity — how much idle time can be spent at once. |
| `maxConcurrent` | `3` | Requests in flight at one time. |
| `cooldownMs` | `120000` | How long one risk signal parks a host. Doubles per consecutive trip. |
| `maxCooldownMs` | `600000` | Ceiling for the doubling cool-down. |
| `timeoutMs` | `20000` | Per-request timeout. |
| `cookie` | `""` | A `SESSDATA=...` string. Only needed for subtitle bodies and the handful of routes that answer `-101` without a session. |
| `douyinBrowser` | `""` | Explicit path to Edge/Chrome. Empty auto-detects. |
| `douyinPort` | `47821` | DevTools port for the helper browser. |
| `douyinUserDataDir` | `""` | Profile directory. Empty uses a temp directory. |
| `douyinKeepAliveMs` | `900000` | How long an idle helper browser stays alive. |
| `douyinWaitMs` | `11000` | Settle time after `loadEventFired` on Douyin. Not padding — the feed hydrates asynchronously. |
| `danmakuLimit` | `500` | Default cap on danmaku rows. |
| `commentPageSize` | `20` | Default comment page size. |

## Douyin sign-in (optional)

`hot` and `feed` need no account. Keyword search does: Douyin gates it behind a login wall and shows "登录后即可搜索更多精彩视频" to anonymous visitors. To unlock it, run `whale_dive_douyin` with `action: "video"` once — this starts the helper browser — then scan the QR code in the window that appears. The session is stored in the plugin's own profile directory (never your normal browser profile) and reused afterwards.

## Output conventions

Two rules run through every tool:

- **A field is only ever omitted, never invented.** When a surface is gated, the tool still *succeeds* and explains the gate in `note`, because "this is gated and here is the way in" is a useful answer and a thrown error is not.
- **Every number is coerced.** Upstream sends `null`, missing keys and `"1.2万"`, all of which would violate the output schema; each is projected to a typed value before the harness validates it.

Rate-limit failures are the exception: they throw an `HttpError` with `code: "RISK"` and `risk: true`, carrying the cool-down window. That distinction is deliberate — a model that reads "intercepted, stop calling this host" behaves differently from one that reads "request failed" and retries into a longer ban.

## Requirements

- DSH `>= 0.2.0-rc.1 < 0.3.0-0`
- Node `>= 20` (the Douyin path uses the global `WebSocket`)
- Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome for the Douyin path; the Bilibili path needs neither

## Scope

Both backends are read-only. Nothing here posts, likes, follows or writes.

## License

MIT.

plugins.description: 给 DeepSeek Harness 用的本地离线汉语词典模式：字/词/成语/歇后语/汉英对译，零依赖插件 + 自带建库脚本
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-cn-dict

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai)（DSH）用的**本地离线汉语词典**：一个 Agent 模式 + 一个模型可见工具，直连本地 SQLite 词库。

> **本仓库只包含代码与文档，不包含任何词库数据。**
> 首次运行建库脚本时会**自动联网下载**所需数据到缓存目录（见[数据来源与下载](#数据来源与下载)）。
> 各数据源的来源与许可状况见 [DATA-LICENSES.md](./DATA-LICENSES.md)——**其中一份上游未声明许可，务必先读**。

## 它提供什么

- **一个 DSH Agent 模式**（`zh-dict`，显示名「汉语词典」）：模式内的会话获得完整标准工具集 + 词典能力，并带三条作答纪律（作答前先查库、未收录要标注来源、不把模型记忆说成词库条目）
- **一个模型可见工具** `dict_lookup`：字级资料（部首/笔画/异体字/文字组件/粤语/闽南音）、词语释义、成语（释义+出处+例句）、歇后语、汉英对译；繁体输入自动折简；另有全文检索

三条作答纪律由模式的人设前缀 + 插件注册的提示词节共同强制，所以它表现为一个**独立的词典模式**，而不是"多了个工具"。

> **最快上手：让 AI 帮你装。** 安装只需改路径、装 bundle、重启客户端，交给一个能读写文件的 AI 编码助手（例如 DSH 自身的 Agent）即可——[安装](#安装)一节里有可直接复制的一段话。安装前建议先扫一眼 [DATA-LICENSES.md](./DATA-LICENSES.md)，数据许可里有一项需要你自己判断。

## 仓库内容

```
dsh-cn-dict/
├─ README.md                  本文件
├─ DATA-LICENSES.md           数据来源、许可、构建期网络访问说明 ← 重要
├─ LICENSE                    代码许可（MIT）
├─ NOTICE                     第三方数据来源与署名要求
├─ package.json               插件包 @GJY-cmd/dsh-cn-dict
├─ index.js                   插件实现（注册 dict_lookup + 提示词节）
├─ tools/
│  └─ build-cn-dict.cjs       建库脚本（下载 → 解压 → 建 SQLite）
└─ preset/                    可选：把「汉语词典」模式装进 profile 的 bundle
   ├─ package.json
   ├─ index.js
   ├─ cordis.patch.yml
   └─ locale/zh.json
```

**不包含**（见[为什么不附带数据](#为什么不附带数据)）：

- `chinese.sqlite`（约 182 MB）
- `cache/`（约 97 MB 源数据）

## 依赖与要求

- **Node.js ≥ 22.5**（需要内置的 `node:sqlite`；实测在 Node 24.21 正常）
- **零第三方依赖**：插件与建库脚本都只用 Node 内置模块（`node:sqlite` / `node:zlib` / `node:http` / `node:fs`）
  - 这一点是刻意的：DSH 的插件常以 junction / symlink 方式链入 profile，Node 会按**真实路径**解析依赖，源码目录没有 `node_modules` 时任何外部依赖都会 `Cannot find package` 并导致整个预设加载失败

## 安装

> ### 建议：让 AI 帮你装
>
> 安装涉及改路径、装 bundle、重启客户端，还要按环境适配——**交给一个能读写文件的 AI 编码助手（例如 DSH 自身的 Agent）最省事，也是本项目推荐的安装方式。**
>
> 在 DSH 里新建会话，把下面这段直接发给它：
>
> ```text
> 帮我在本机安装 dsh-cn-dict（DSH 的本地离线汉语词典插件）。
> 代码在当前工作目录（或我给你的路径）。请先完整读 README.md 与 DATA-LICENSES.md，
> 然后：1) 运行建库脚本生成词库（需要联网下载约 98 MB 数据）；
> 2) 把插件与 preset 安装进我当前的 DSH profile；
> 3) 校验预设能被加载、dict_lookup 工具可用；
> 4) 最后告诉我该怎么验证（我该新建会话还是需要重启客户端）。
> 遇到报错先读文档里的「常见报错」和「技术要点」，不要随手改 profile 配置。
> ```
>
> 两点交代清楚，能显著提高一次成功率：
>
> - **让它先读文档再动手**——安装的坑（profile 配置不能手改、插件必须零依赖、`Config` 必须是 Standard Schema）都写在[技术要点](#技术要点这些坑别踩回去)里，AI 读了就不会重踩
> - **把词库路径交给它决定**，或明确告诉它你想放哪（词库约 182 MB，建议放在有空间的盘）
>
> 你仍然需要自己确认两件事：**数据来源的许可**（见 [DATA-LICENSES.md](./DATA-LICENSES.md)）与**词库落盘位置**。
>
> 下面是手工步骤，供想自己动手或排查问题时使用。

插件包需要能被 profile 解析到。两种方式：

### A. 本地包 + junction（开发/自用）

1. 把本仓库放到一个固定目录，例如 `D:\dsh-cn-dict`
2. 让 profile 能解析到它（示例为 Windows 的 junction）：
   ```powershell
   New-Item -ItemType Junction `
     -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\<profile>\node_modules\@GJY-cmd\dsh-cn-dict" `
     -Target "D:\dsh-cn-dict"
   ```
3. 在 profile 的 bundle patch 里声明它，或直接用下面的 `preset/` 安装模式

### B. 用 `preset/` 安装「汉语词典」模式

1. 编辑 `preset/cordis.patch.yml`，把 `cn-dict` 那一行的 `dbPath` 改成你的词库路径
2. 用 DSH 的插件管理器安装这个 bundle（`plugin_manager` → `install_bundle`，目标为该目录的绝对路径）
3. 重启 DSH，新建会话时模式列表里会出现「汉语词典」

> 注意：DSH 的 profile 配置（`package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 与 `cordis.patch.yml`）**只能由应用自己的机制写入**。手工编辑会被应用重写掉——这是踩过的坑。

## 数据来源与下载

建库脚本**自带下载**：首次运行时会把需要的文件取到缓存目录，**这一步需要联网**。

| 文件 | 字节数 | 下载地址 |
|---|---|---|
| `word.json` | 27,354,320 | GitHub：`pwxcoo/chinese-xinhua` → `data/word.json` |
| `ci.json` | 26,129,191 | 同上 → `data/ci.json` |
| `idiom.json` | 10,319,857 | 同上 → `data/idiom.json` |
| `xiehouyu.json` | 约 1.2 MB | 同上 → `data/xiehouyu.json` |
| `Dictionary.json` | 33,190,508 | GitHub：`max32002/chinese_dictionary` → 根目录 ⚠️ 见许可说明 |
| `cedict.txt.gz` | 3,981,100 | CC-CEDICT 官方导出：`https://www.mdbg.net/chinese/export/cedict/cedict_1_0_ts_utf-8_mdbg.txt.gz` |

合计约 **97.7 MB**；已就绪的文件不会重复下载。

几点说明：

- **字节数用于校验**：脚本按上表核对。大小一致即说明版本相符；不一致会报出是哪个文件、实际多少字节，并拒绝使用。
- **GitHub 访问**：部分网络环境下 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 直连受限，脚本因此在两个公共 GitHub 代理前缀（`ghproxy.net`、`gh-proxy.com`）之间轮换重试。**这是第三方代理**，请求会经过它们：
  - 它们与本项目无关联，可用性、稳定性与隐私处理**不作任何保证**
  - 支持直连的环境建议改脚本用直连（把代理前缀数组留空即可）
  - 也可以完全不用脚本下载：自行把文件放进缓存目录，脚本按字节数校验后会直接使用

- **`max32002` 有两个版本可选**：`Dictionary.json`（8 万字，但只有「部首/笔画」完整）与 `Dictionary_lite.json`（1 万字，但部首/笔画/异体字/同义字/文字组件**都完整**）。上表用的是完整版，也就是本项目的默认用法。
- **`cedict.txt.gz` 必须是 gzip**：脚本按 gz 读取。若你从其他渠道拿到未压缩文本，请自行压缩并命名为 `cedict.txt.gz`。

## 构建词库

```powershell
node tools/build-cn-dict.cjs <缓存目录> <输出.sqlite>
# 例：
node tools/build-cn-dict.cjs D:\dsh-cn-dict-data\cache D:\dsh-cn-dict-data\chinese.sqlite
```

- 首次运行会下载缺的源文件到缓存目录（已存在的按字节数校验后跳过）
- 输出库每次重建，重跑是幂等的
- 实测：下载约 5 分钟（取决于网络），建库本身约 10 秒，成品库约 182 MB

### 常见报错

| 现象 | 原因与处理 |
|---|---|
| 卡在下载 / `HTTP 403` / `HTTP 502` | GitHub 直连或所用代理受限。换代理、改直连，或自行下载文件放进缓存目录 |
| `下载失败：size mismatch` | 拿到的版本不同或文件不完整。换渠道重下；若确认版本无误，可改脚本 `SOURCES` 表里该项的期望字节数 |
| `cedict.txt.gz` 取不到 | mdbg.net 的导出是动态端点，偶发不可用。从 [CC-CEDICT 项目主页](https://cc-cedict.org/wiki/start) 找其他渠道，压缩成 gz 后命名为 `cedict.txt.gz` 放进缓存目录 |
| `词库未收录`（查询时） | 不是建库问题——上游数据本身没有该词条，属[已知限制](#已知限制) |
| 控制台中文显示为乱码 | 通常是 Windows 控制台编码问题，不影响写入数据库；用 `chcp 65001` 或换终端确认 |

### 形成的表结构

| 表 | 内容 | 来源 |
|---|---|---|
| `chars` | 字级：部首、部首笔画、总笔画、异体字、同义字、文字组件、普通话/粤语/闽南音、Unicode | `max32002/chinese_dictionary` ⚠️ 见许可说明 |
| `words` | 字条与词条释义、拼音、笔画 | `pwxcoo/chinese-xinhua`（MIT） |
| `ci` | 词语释义 | `pwxcoo/chinese-xinhua`（MIT） |
| `idioms` | 成语：释义、出处、例句、拼音、缩写 | `pwxcoo/chinese-xinhua`（MIT） |
| `xiehouyu` | 歇后语：谜面 → 谜底 | `pwxcoo/chinese-xinhua`（MIT） |
| `english` | 汉英对译 | CC-CEDICT（CC BY-SA 4.0） |
| `simp_of` | 繁 → 简映射 | 由上述来源推导 |
| `search_fts` | 跨表全文索引（FTS5） | 推导 |

### 只用许可清晰的来源（推荐做法）

若你不希望引入许可不明的那一份，**不提供 `Dictionary.json` 即可**——脚本会跳过 `chars` 表，其余表照常建。代价是失去字级资料（部首/笔画/异体字/文字组件/粤语闽南音），字条释义仍可由 `chinese-xinhua` 提供。此时全部数据仅剩 MIT + CC BY-SA 4.0 两份，组合库按 CC BY-SA 4.0 发布即可。

（若你希望脚本在缺失该文件时直接失败而不是跳过，把 `FILES` 表里该项标记为必需即可。）

## 配置

| 配置项 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `dbPath` | 无（必填） | 词库 SQLite 路径；插件配置或环境变量 `DSH_CN_DICT_DB` |
| `defaultLimit` | `5` | 单次返回条数上限 |
| `includeEnglish` | `true` | 中文条目是否附英文对译 |

配置通过插件的 `Config`（Standard Schema 接口）声明，可在 profile 的 patch 行 `config` 里覆盖。

## 工具行为

```
dict_lookup(word, mode?, detail?, limit?, english?)
```

- `mode: lookup`（默认）——精确查词：字、词语、成语、歇后语、汉英；繁体自动折简；未收录时返回前缀相近词条，并提示改用模型自身知识且需标注
- `mode: search`——全文检索：按释义找词、按部件找字等
- `detail: brief|normal|full`——释义详细度，**默认 `brief`**；`full` 才输出完整原文与例句
- `english: false` 可关掉中文条目的英文对译

## token 开销（实测）

用 `deepseek-flash`、缓存命中率约 96% 的会话测得：

| 项 | 优化前 | 现版本 |
|---|---|---|
| 工具定义（每轮请求都发） | 585 tok | **331 tok** |
| 提示词节（每轮请求都发） | 278 tok | **92 tok** |
| 固定合计 | 863 tok/请求 | **423 tok/请求** |
| 单次查字 | 365 tok | **56 tok** |
| 单次成语 | 294 tok | **156 tok** |
| 10 词任务内容 | 1479 tok | **641 tok** |

做过的优化：

1. **字条/词条去重**——查单字时 `chars` 与 `words` 描述同一条目，原先各输出一遍
2. **`detail` 档位**——源数据释义是上千字符的无差别长文（古文例句、交叉引用），按行截断即去掉绝大部分噪声
3. **压缩固定开销**——工具定义 471→187 字符、提示词节 323→104 字符（原先把纪律条款写了两遍）；成语查询时【词语】那份长文压成一句，因为【成语】条目已给出完整权威释义

### 关于额度，一个诚实的说明

固定开销虽然每轮都发，但**绝大部分会命中上下文缓存**，按缓存命中价计费（比未命中输入便宜约 50 倍、比输出便宜 200 倍）。以实测的一轮为例（未缓存输入 934 / 缓存读取 25,856 / 输出 784）：

- 单轮成本 ≈ ¥0.0046（空闲价）/ ¥0.0092（高峰价）
- **输出占 68%**，未缓存输入 20%，缓存读取仅 11%
- 词典插件自身的固定开销 ≈ **¥0.0000085/轮**，1000 轮不到一分钱

也就是说：省固定头部的实际收益远小于"省输出"。若你要进一步压，优先压**工具返回内容的长度**（那部分每轮都是新增 token，进不了缓存），而不是压固定头部。

## 已知限制

1. **没有单一权威开源「全量现代汉语词典」**。本词库是三份开源数据拼合：常用字词、成语、歇后语覆盖较好，但收词量不等同于《现代汉语词典》（那是版权作品）。
2. **部分常用词缺纯中文释义**：例如「苹果」只能给汉英对译，因为所用开源数据里没有该词的独立中文条目。此时模型会按纪律标注并自行补充。
3. **笔画数两套口径**：`chars.strokes_total` 来自 `max32002`（繁体字形口径），`words.strokes` 来自 `chinese-xinhua`（简体口径）；同一字可能差 1，当前按来源分别展示。
4. **`words.explanation` 原始释义是长文**（含古文例句与交叉引用，单条可达上千字符），由 `detail` 档位截断，`full` 才完整输出。
5. **建库需要联网**（脚本自带下载），且依赖 GitHub 与 mdbg.net 可达；部分网络环境需要镜像/代理。详见[数据来源与下载](#数据来源与下载)与 [DATA-LICENSES.md](./DATA-LICENSES.md)。

## 为什么不附带数据

1. **许可**：组合库包含 CC BY-SA 4.0 的 CC-CEDICT（传染性），且含一份**上游未声明许可**的数据，直接分发有风险。详见 [DATA-LICENSES.md](./DATA-LICENSES.md)。
2. **体积**：182 MB 的 SQLite 加 97 MB 源文件不适合放进 git 仓库或 npm 包（GitHub 单文件 100 MB 上限）。

所以本仓库只放"如何构建"，由使用者自行获取数据。

## 许可

- **代码**：MIT，见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)
- **数据**：**不适用 MIT**。你自行构建出的词库受各上游数据源许可约束，见 [NOTICE](./NOTICE) 与 [DATA-LICENSES.md](./DATA-LICENSES.md)

## 关于本仓库本身

本仓库是**已就绪的发布物**：代码已清掉开发期的本地路径与前缀，文档中的占位符也已替换为实际值。
因此原文档里「发布前需要替换的占位符」「发布前：代码需要对齐本文档」两节已不再适用，故移除。

仓库里**不包含**词库与源数据（体积大且受第三方许可约束），建议的 `.gitignore` 已随仓库提供。
## 技术要点（这些坑别踩回去）

| 要点 | 原因 |
|---|---|
| **插件

plugins.description: Live-preview panel for DeepSeek Harness: preview workspace pages beside the chat, auto-reload on save. · DeepSeek Harness 实时预览插件：边聊边看你的页面，改完自动刷新。
plugins.readme_text:
# Live Preview for DeepSeek Harness

[中文说明](./README.zh-CN.md) · [Changelog](./CHANGELOG.md) · MIT

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a **live-preview panel** to the Web UI. Pick a workspace, browse to an HTML
page, and it renders beside the conversation — every save reloads it. The agent can open pages too, through the
`live_preview` tool.

> Built for the "let me see what you are making" loop: chat on the left, your page on the right, no window
> switching.

## Features

- Preview panel docked to the right of the Harness UI; drag its left edge to resize, width and device mode are remembered
- Workspace → directory → file browser with an `HTML` badge
- **Auto reload on save** (SSE, with a version-poll fallback), toggleable, plus a manual reload button.
  Only files the preview actually loaded trigger a reload, so unrelated workspace activity (service logs, data
  dumps) does not keep reloading your page.
- **Focus on what is being edited** — the preview scrolls to and outlines the block that just changed, and the panel
  shows an "Editing …" chip; automatic on save (HTML by source line, CSS by rule selector) and available through the tool
- Device widths: full / 768 px / 375 px, and open-in-new-tab
- **Survives a Harness restart** — the last open page is remembered in the browser and restored when the panel
  was open, so a restart no longer leaves it blank
- **Separate window** — open the preview in your system default browser and collapse the in-panel view, so the
  conversation gets its space back; live reload / focus keep working in that window
- Agent tool `live_preview` with `open` / `close` / `refresh` / `root` / `focus` / `clear`
- Read-only preview server on loopback, one-time token + HttpOnly cookie, realpath containment checks
- The previewed page runs on its own origin, isolated from the Harness UI origin

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness with the Web UI (the `dsh web` app or the desktop app)
- Node.js 20+ on the Harness host

## Install

1. Clone this repository anywhere on the Harness host.
2. Install it as a local bundle — ask the Harness agent, or call the plugin manager directly:

   ```
   plugin_manager install_bundle(target: "/absolute/path/to/dsh-live-preview")
   ```

   (In the UI: Plugins → Add → local bundle directory.)
3. **Refresh the Web UI** (Ctrl+R). An eye icon appears in the session header.

> A local-directory install links the checkout in place. If you move or delete the folder, reinstall the bundle.

## Use

- **Eye icon** — open / close the preview panel
- **Workspace dropdown** — switch the preview root (registered workspaces only)
- **Choose file** — browse folders, click an HTML file to preview it, click a folder to enter
- **Full / Tablet / Phone** — preview width (phone = 375 px)
- **Auto reload** — whether file changes reload the page
- **Reload** — reload the current page manually
- **Open in a new tab** — hand the page to your system browser
- **Separate window** — open the preview in your default browser and close the panel, for when the panel feels
  too wide; auto reload and the edit highlight keep working there. (The desktop shell blocks `window.open`, so
  the Host opens it instead.)
- Drag the panel's left edge to resize it

Ask the agent to open a page for you:

```
Open the live preview on maas-home-preview/index.html
```

The agent calls `live_preview({ action: "open", path: "maas-home-preview/index.html" })`.

## Focus — show the block being edited

When a watched file changes, the plugin works out *where* the edit landed and tells the preview to point at it:

- **HTML** — served pages carry `data-lp-line` markers on elements. The change is diffed against the last served
  revision, and the element nearest the changed source line is scrolled into view and outlined.
- **CSS** — the selector of the rule surrounding the changed line is resolved and every matching element is outlined
  (up to 12).
- Other text files — the panel still shows "Editing … · line N" without a page outline.

The focus is carried through the reload (stored in `sessionStorage`), so it lands after the page has reloaded.
You can also drive it explicitly:

```jsonc
{ "action": "focus", "selector": "#hero" }
{ "action": "focus", "path": "index.html", "line": 312 }
{ "action": "clear" }
```

The panel shows the current target with **Locate** (re-apply) and **×** (clear) actions; it fades after ~15 seconds.

## Configuration

Edit the plugin row's `config` in your `cordis.patch.yml` patch layer:

```yaml
- id: dsh-live-preview
  config:
    port: 8123              # 0 = pick a free port; a busy port falls back automatically
    autoReload: true        # broadcast reloads by default
    roots: []               # extra absolute directories allowed as preview roots
    ignore: ["node_modules", ".git", "dist", "build", ".tmp", ".venv"]
    panelWidthRatio: 0.46   # initial panel width
```

## How it works

```
Harness Web UI (:59936, authenticated)
├── session header utilities  → eye toggle (client plugin)
├── shell.overlay             → preview panel (React, theme tokens)
│        │ fetch same-origin JSON API (/dsh-live-preview/*)
│        │ iframe → loopback preview server
└────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────
         ▼
Host plugin (zero dependencies)
├── loopback preview server :8123 (read-only)
│   ├── static files + reload script injection
│   ├── per-file fs.watch (only served files) → SSE reload (+ /__live/version fallback)
│   └── token + cookie auth, realpath containment
└── same-origin API: /info /state /tree /root /panel /refresh
```

`live_preview` opens a page by resolving the path against the caller's session working directory, then picking
the nearest registered workspace as the preview root.

## Security model

- The preview server binds `127.0.0.1` only
- Every file request needs the per-process random token (`?t=`) or the `dshprev` HttpOnly cookie
- Read-only: no write endpoint
- Each request is checked with `realpath` + containment; `..`, encoded traversal and symlink escapes are rejected
- The previewed page gets its own origin, so it cannot read the Harness UI's storage or authenticated API
- No LAN or remote access

## Limitations

- Static files only; a project that needs `npm run dev` is not proxied (planned)
- Pages that call absolute-path backend endpoints will 404
- If the page's own CSP blocks the injected reload script, the panel-side fallback still reloads it — that fallback
  needs one page refresh after installing/updating
- The boot contract (`window.__ModuleLoader__`, slot APIs) is internal to Harness; a major Harness upgrade may need a
  small plugin update

## Development

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/2011126630z-commits/dsh-live-preview
cd dsh-live-preview
npm test        # node:test — auth, traversal, MIME, injection (syntax-checked), SSE, port fallback, cleanup
```

## License

MIT

# dsh-feishu-writer

> **The missing "write" side of Feishu for DeepSeek Harness** — let your agent create Feishu docs, spreadsheets, Bitables and wiki spaces.
> 飞书"读"的插件有了、"聊"的插件也有了，**"写"是空白**——这个插件让 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 把产出直接写进飞书。

## What it does

Registers 4 model-facing tools:

| Tool | Capability | Returns |
|------|-----------|---------|
| `feishu_write_doc` | Create a Feishu doc (Markdown body) | `{"document_id":"...","url":"..."}` |
| `feishu_write_sheet` | Create a spreadsheet, optionally pre-filled with a 2D array | sheet info + written range |
| `feishu_write_bitable` | Create a BitTable (BaseApp) in a workspace | `{"app_token":"...","url":"..."}` |
| `feishu_write_wiki` | Create a wiki space | `{"space_id":"...","name":"..."}` |

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin add <owner>/dsh-feishu-writer
```

## Prerequisites (required)

1. Install the official Feishu/Lark CLI: `npx @larksuite/cli@latest install`
2. Log in once: `lark-cli auth login --recommend` (opens a browser authorization page)

**Windows 可执行文件解析**：插件从不经过 shell 执行 lark-cli（注入安全），但 Windows 上 npm 装的
`lark-cli` 只有 `.cmd` 垫片、无法被 `spawn` 直接执行。插件按以下顺序解析真正的 `lark-cli.exe`：

1. `LARK_CLI_BIN` 环境变量（指向 lark-cli.exe 完整路径，最高优先级）；
2. PATH 中的 `lark-cli.exe`；
3. npm 全局安装位置 `%APPDATA%\npm\node_modules\@larksuite\cli\bin\lark-cli.exe`。

解析失败时工具返回明确的修复提示，不会崩溃。

If the plugin detects a missing CLI or an expired login, the tool call fails with a clear
fix-up hint instead of crashing.

## Usage examples

**"帮我写一份本周周报，存到飞书文档"**
```
agent → feishu_write_doc(title="第42周周报", content="# 本周进展\n- 完成 RAG 检索优化\n- 上线评测闭环")
agent → {"document_id":"...","url":"https://xxx.feishu.cn/docx/..."}
```

**"把这些数据整理成飞书表格"**
```
agent → feishu_write_sheet(title="季度数据", values='[["月份","营收"],["Q1",120],["Q2",150]]')
```

**"把研究结果沉淀到知识库"**
```
agent → feishu_write_wiki(name="AI 应用开发笔记", description="RAG/Agent/评测 实战沉淀")
```

**BitTable needs a workspace token**（在飞书多维表格工作区 URL 中获取，形如 `base/workspace/<token>`）:
```
agent → feishu_write_bitable(name="项目看板", workspaceToken="GUs9soB...")
```

## R2 权限披露（DSH-Store R2 级）

本插件属于 **R2 级**（外部进程 + 网络 + 凭据），逐项披露如下：

| 能力 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| 外部进程 | shell out 调用 `lark-cli`（飞书官方 CLI，MIT）。**不使用 shell 解释器**：参数数组直传 `spawn`，模型/用户内容不会被解释为 shell 语法（注入安全） |
| 网络 | 由 lark-cli 发起对飞书 OpenAPI 的 HTTPS 调用 |
| 凭据 | 完全复用 lark-cli 的 OAuth 凭据（存于系统 keychain），**本插件不读取、不存储、不转发任何 token** |
| 外部依赖 | `@larksuite/cli`（npm，飞书官方维护）；建议固定版本 |

## Security & boundaries

- All tool content is passed as `spawn` argv or a temp file — **never through a shell**.
- Tools only **create** objects; they do not delete, share, or modify existing content (write-only scope).
- Errors (not installed / expired login / API failure) surface as actionable messages with fix-up hints.
- Review the objects created before sharing: wiki spaces default to **private**.

## Development

```bash
npm install
npm run typecheck
npm test
npm run build
npm pack
```

Local mount & verify:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-feishu-writer-0.1.0.tgz
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep feishu_write
dsh run "用 feishu_write_doc 创建一篇标题为测试的文档"
```

## License

MIT. Uses the Feishu/Lark Open Platform via lark-cli — using those APIs requires
compliance with Feishu's terms and privacy policy.

plugins.description: 把 DSH 回答里的数学公式复制成可在 Obsidian / LaTeX 中重新渲染的 TeX：悬停公式复制、选中带公式的文本时还原源码。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-math-copy

[![ci](https://github.com/SOH4C4759/dsh-math-copy/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/SOH4C4759/dsh-math-copy/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

> 演示：[把 DSH 里的公式复制成能重新渲染的 TeX](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1vVn56pEqi)（24 秒实录，无配音）

把 DSH 回答里的数学公式，复制成 **能在 Obsidian / LaTeX 里重新渲染的 TeX**，而不是一堆字形。

回答里的公式是 KaTeX 画出来的：看得见、选得中，但 Ctrl+C 之后进剪贴板的是 `𝑒^𝑖𝜋+1=0` 这样的 Unicode 字形——粘进 Obsidian 只会得到一行怪符号。这个插件把公式还原成源码：

- **悬停任意公式** → 浮出一个小条，三个复制目标：
  - `Obsidian` → 行内 `$…$`，独立公式 `$$…$$`
  - `LaTeX` → 行内 `\(…\)`，独立公式 `\[…\]`
  - `TeX` → 只给源码，不带定界符（一次性，不改后续格式）
- **选中带公式的一段文本再 Ctrl+C** → 剪贴板里是这段文本，其中每个公式都被还原成源码（用你上次点的 `Obsidian` / `LaTeX` 目标），整段直接粘进 Obsidian 就能渲染。
- 选中里没有公式时，插件完全不插手，复制行为与原来一致。

## 为什么源码是准的

KaTeX 渲染时会在视觉标记旁边同时输出 MathML，里面带一个
`<annotation encoding="application/x-tex">`，内容就是模型写的那段 TeX 原文。
插件只读这个 annotation，不猜、不从字形反推：

- 拿不到 annotation 的公式（渲染失败、被裁掉的节点）不会出现复制条，选中路径也会跳过它；
- 支持多行环境（`\begin{aligned}…\end{aligned}` 原样保留）；
- 不修改对话 DOM，只往页面上追加自己的浮条和提示，卸载时全部移除。

上次用过的目标记在 `localStorage['dsh.math-copy.format']`，默认 `obsidian`。
`TeX` 按钮故意不写入这个记录：临时要源码，不该把「整段还原」也变成裸源码。

## 安装

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:<本仓库绝对路径>
```

也可以从 DSH 的插件页安装同一个路径。装好后 profile 里是这一行：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: math-copy
      name: dsh-math-copy
```

装完插件即可用。**改过 `lib/client.js` 之后要刷新页面**（浏览器端 bundle 是页面启动时
import 的）；改 Host 半边才需要重启 DSH。

## 开发与验证

```powershell
node build-client.mjs        # src/client.js -> lib/client.js（校验 loader shell）
node --check lib/client.js
node tools/verify-client.mjs # VM + stub DOM：剪贴板载荷、annotation 提取、apply 接线
node tools/harness-run.mjs   # 无头 Edge + CDP：真的把公式 DOM 建出来跑一遍
```

`node` 不在 PATH 上时用 DSH 自带那一份：

```powershell
& "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\node\bin\node.exe" tools\harness-run.mjs
```

没有 Edge 时 harness 会打印 `SKIP` 与原因（不会被当成通过）。

| 路径 | 是什么 |
|---|---|
| `entry.js` | Host 半边，空的：复制公式是页面的事，不需要路由、进程或设置项。 |
| `src/client.js` | 真正的实现（悬停浮条、选区还原、剪贴板回退、提示）。 |
| `lib/client.js` | 构建产物，由 `build-client.mjs` 从源码复制并校验；CI 会验证它与源码一致。 |
| `tools/verify-client.mjs` | 在 VM 里跑纯逻辑：三种目标的剪贴板载荷、annotation 提取、`apply()` 的监听与两个空槽位消费者。 |
| `tools/harness.html` + `tools/harness-run.mjs` | 用真实 KaTeX 结构造出公式，在无头 Edge 里跑 20 条断言：浮条出现/定位/不自动关闭、四种载荷、选区还原（含「无公式不拦截」）、滚动收起。`--dump-dom` 在本机对 HTML 页面返回空，所以改用 CDP 读页面结果。 |
| `tools/serve.mjs` | 单独起一个静态服务调试 harness 用。 |

CI（`.github/workflows/ci.yml`）跑语法检查、产物一致性、离线套件与浏览器 harness；
`.github/workflows/release.yml` 在 `v*` tag 或手动触发时打包 zip + npm tarball、在解包产物上
重跑离线套件，再发 Release。

## 已知边界

- 依赖 KaTeX 的 `.katex` / `.katex-display` 类名（KaTeX 自己的稳定契约），不依赖
  DSH 的 CSS Modules 哈希类名。
- 选区还原只在 `copy` 事件上生效；页面自己的「复制消息」按钮走
  `navigator.clipboard.writeText`，不经过这个事件——但它复制的是原始 markdown，
  本来就带 `$$`，不需要转换。
- 行内公式按 `$…$` 复制。源码里自带 `$` 的极端写法不做转义。
- 浮条靠悬停出现，纯键盘操作暂时取不到；需要的话可以再加一个消息级「复制全部公式」动作。

## 许可

[MIT](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: A scholarly journal-desk skin for DeepSeek Harness: Nature, Science, IEEE and Elsevier covers, manuscript stages, and an editorial letter behind the conversation.
plugins.readme_text:
# Paper Skin · Journal Desk

A quiet, scholarly skin for **DeepSeek Harness**. Choose the paper you are publishing today — *Nature*, *Science*, *IEEE* or *Elsevier* — set the manuscript stage, and a professional editorial letter settles behind the conversation.

> A typographic homage only. This project is not affiliated with Nature, Science, AAAS, IEEE or Elsevier.

![Paper Skin in DeepSeek Harness](docs/preview-nature.webp)

## What it does

- **Journal masthead.** The sidebar becomes a deep cover-coloured spine with a typographic wordmark, a circular cover thumbnail, a journal descriptor and a slim colophon showing volume and stage.
- **Four covers.** Pick a journal from the small journal-cover button beside Harness **Settings**. The lower-left sidebar carries a slim colophon instead of a bulky journal switcher.
- **Manuscript progress.** Choose the stage in the same skin panel:
  - **初审 · With Editor** — initial editorial assessment
  - **中期 · Under Review** — peer review
  - **大修 · Major Revision** — revise and resubmit
  - **小修 · Minor Revision** — minor revision anticipated
  - **录用 · Accepted** — formal letter of acceptance
  - **见刊 · Published** — final article online
- **A professional letter, behind the conversation.** The selected stage renders a letter as the conversation background: a large stage word, editorial-office wording, manuscript number, date and a circular seal. It is a real CSS background layer, not a composer banner. Its visibility is adjustable from **5% to 80%**, and its colour can follow the manuscript stage or be set from a palette or the custom colour picker.
- **Journal artwork.** All four covers use the artwork in `assets/`: the Nature, Science and IEEE covers, and the Elsevier tree plus wordmark. The same artwork appears in the small journal button, the hero seal and the sidebar mark.
- **Visible paper grain.** A laid-paper texture runs across the conversation, composer, settings panel and sidebar, and can be switched off entirely.
- **Light & dark.** Paper, cover ink and watermark adapt to the Harness colour scheme.
- **Local only.** Choices live in this browser’s `localStorage` under `dsh.paper-skin.v1`. The skin makes no external network requests and collects no data.

![Paper Skin settings panel](docs/preview-panel.webp)

## Use

After installation, reload the page once.

1. The small journal-cover button sits beside Harness **Settings** at the lower left.
2. Click it to choose a journal and a manuscript stage.
3. The sidebar, cover colour, typography and the editorial letter behind the conversation change together.
4. `Accepted` uses a formal letter of acceptance; every other stage uses the corresponding editorial-office language.

The floating quick-settings pattern takes after [open-sea-skin](https://github.com/d-dev0101/open-sea-skin); the panel and skin here are an independent implementation. `open-sea-skin` is not required.

## Install

Paper Skin is a self-contained DeepSeek Harness bundle: one Host row (`paper-skin`), one Web client module, and a read-only local asset route. There are no runtime dependencies and no build step.

### From GitHub

Install the tagged release straight from the public repository:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:1552421144-cloud/paper-skin#v1.0.0
```

Or open Harness **Plugins → Add plugin → Install a third-party plugin**, paste the same `github:...` spec, install, then enable **Paper Skin · Journal Desk**.

### From a release tarball

Download `paper-skin-1.0.0.tgz` from the [release page](https://github.com/1552421144-cloud/paper-skin/releases), then install it into the same profile that runs Harness:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/to/paper-skin-1.0.0.tgz
```

For the macOS Desktop app, the bundled CLI is:

```sh
"/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" \
  plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/to/paper-skin-1.0.0.tgz
```

Restart Harness, reload the page once, then open **Plugins** and confirm **Paper Skin · Journal Desk** is enabled. The bundle row is `paper-skin`.

### From npm

Once the package is published to npm, install an exact version:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add paper-skin@1.0.0
```

Or open Harness **Plugins → Add plugin**, enter `paper-skin@1.0.0`, install, and enable **Paper Skin · Journal Desk**.

### From a checkout

For development against a working copy:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:/absolute/path/to/paper-skin"
```

## Uninstall

Remove **Paper Skin** in **Plugins**, or:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove paper-skin
```

Unloading removes the CSS, root attributes, background watermark and every slot entry. The localStorage key remains until cleared.

## Compatibility

Verified against DeepSeek Harness Desktop **0.2.1-rc.2** on macOS. The client half uses the standard Web slots listed below, so it also works in a `dsh web` profile that has the same client packages. It does not modify the Harness checkout.

## Files

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `client.js` | Browser skin: React slots, covers, stage letters, colour and opacity controls, CSS and the settings panel. |
| `index.js` | Host half; serves the cover artwork from `assets/`. It registers no tools, model context or session routes. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch inserting the `paper-skin` row. |
| `locale/*.json` | Plugin-manager metadata (English and Chinese). |
| `icon.svg` | Original journal-cover icon. |
| `assets/*` | Optimised Nature/Science/IEEE covers, the Elsevier cover, and the transparent Elsevier tree mark. |
| `docs/*.webp` | Screenshots used by this README. |
| `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` | Trademark and artwork attribution. |

## Slots

- `sidebar.brand.mark`, `sidebar.brand.name`
- `sidebar.footer.action` (slim colophon, not a switcher)
- `conversation.hero.brand.mark`
- `shell.overlay` (the only journal/stage switcher)

The conversation letter is a CSS background on the transcript surface; it adds no transcript rows. Cover artwork is served locally by the Host half from `assets/`. No app-root replacement, no external network requests.

## Packaging a release

```sh
npm pack
```

The resulting `paper-skin-1.0.0.tgz` contains only the runtime files, locales, icon, artwork, screenshots and documentation. The repository and release are at [1552421144-cloud/paper-skin](https://github.com/1552421144-cloud/paper-skin). Publishing to npm is optional and would allow installation by package name:

```sh
npm publish
```

## Licence

MIT for the plugin code. Journal and publisher names and the cover artwork are used descriptively; they are not official endorsements, and the artwork is not covered by the MIT licence. See [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). All trademarks remain with their owners.

plugins.description: DSH plugin: restyles the conversation scrollbar to match the Visual Studio Code editor (14px, flat translucent thumb, light and dark themes).
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-vscode-scrollbar

A DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin that gives the conversation the **Visual Studio Code** editor chrome:

- the **VS Code scrollbar** — a 14px always-visible bar with a flat, translucent thumb that darkens on
  hover and lightens while you drag it, and
- the **VS Code minimap** — a scaled-down preview column on the right that shows the whole
  conversation, with a viewport slider you can drag or click to navigate.

The stock Harness scrollbar is a 5px, rounded, overlay-style bar and the conversation has no minimap
at all. This plugin changes only the conversation's scroll column; every other scrollbar in the app
(menus, code blocks, sidebars, the composer) keeps the stock look.

## What changes

**Scrollbar**

| Property | Harness default | With this plugin |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Track width | 5px | 14px |
| Track background | transparent | transparent |
| Thumb shape | pill (`border-radius:999px`, inset border) | flat rectangle, no radius |
| Thumb — light theme | theme scrollbar alias | `rgba(100,100,100,.4)` (`#64646466`) |
| Thumb — dark theme | theme scrollbar alias | `rgba(121,121,121,.4)` (`#79797966`) |
| Hover | theme scrollbar alias | `rgba(100,100,100,.7)` (`#646464B3`) |
| Dragging (active) | theme scrollbar alias | `rgba(191,191,191,.4)` (`#BFBFBF66`) |
| Scrollbar buttons | none | none |

These are VS Code's own defaults (`scrollbarSlider.*` in its light and dark themes;
`editor.scrollbar.verticalScrollbarSize` = 14). Dark mode is read from the
`body[data-ds-dark-theme]` attribute that the Harness theme service sets, so the colors follow the
active palette exactly like VS Code does — no plugin-wide color override, no second theme system.

**Minimap**

| Property | Harness default | With this plugin |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Preview column | none | 80px column flush against the scrollbar, capped at half the window height |
| Content | none | snapshot of the whole conversation, scaled into the column; images are painted, heavyweight media (video/canvas/SVG/forms) is dropped |
| Viewport slider | none | VS Code `minimapSlider`: square translucent band, visible only while hovering the minimap or dragging |
| Checkpoint rail | right-aligned at the edge, hidden under the preview | parked 110px from the right edge, left of the column and fully visible |
| Click | n/a | jumps the conversation to that point and keeps dragging from there |
| Drag / wheel | n/a | drag scrubs the conversation, the wheel scrolls it |
| "加载更早" pages | collapsed behind a button | expanded automatically, so older turns are never folded away |
| Minimum pane width | n/a | 1180px — below that the column hides instead of covering text |

## Behaviour

- The minimap only appears when there is spare room. The chat column is capped at 920px, so on wide
  windows the preview sits in the empty right margin; on a narrow window it hides rather than covering
  the messages. It also stays hidden while the conversation is shorter than the viewport.
- The column is flush against the scrollbar and capped at half the window height. Inside that column
  the whole conversation is mapped 1:1 through the preview scale, so the slider marks the exact
  preview slice the viewport is showing. (VS Code itself uses the full editor height; the cap is this
  plugin's only deliberate deviation from it.)
- The slider is VS Code's `minimapSlider`: a square translucent band in the scrollbar-slider colors
  that only appears while the pointer is over the minimap or while dragging (`showSlider: mouseover`).
  Its size and offset come from the conversation's own numbers (`viewportHeight * scaleY`,
  `scrollTop * scaleY`), never from the native scrollbar thumb.
- Clicking anywhere in the minimap centres the viewport on that line and then keeps the same gesture
  as a drag, so press-and-drag scrubs continuously. The wheel over the minimap scrolls the
  conversation, as it does over VS Code's minimap.
- Harness's turn-navigation rail (the short checkpoint bars on the right edge) keeps its stock position
  until the preview appears, then moves out of the column's way and stays clickable.
- Harness paginates old turns behind a "加载更早" / "Load earlier" button. The plugin clicks it as soon
  as it renders (paced while the button is in its disabled "加载中" state, capped at 500 pages), so the
  conversation is not folded into that bucket. This cannot be turned off without disabling the plugin.
- The preview refreshes after new content settles, debounced by 350 ms, so a streaming answer does not
  rebuild the clone on every token. Scrolling is rAF-throttled.
- It is read-only: interactions pass through the preview, and the clone has its ids, SVG, canvas, video,
  form controls and running animations removed, so it stays cheap and cannot interfere with the real
  conversation.

## Install / 安装

Install from GitHub into the profile you use:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:azkbzxf/dsh-vscode-scrollbar
```

Or install a local checkout through the plugin manager tool:

```json
{ "action": "install_bundle", "target": "D:\\path\\to\\dsh-vscode-scrollbar" }
```

A newly added bundle activates on the running instance: the Host row is live immediately and the
Client half hot-loads into the open page. Replacing an already-installed copy needs the page to be
reloaded (or DSH restarted) before the fresh client build is used.

Remove it again with:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-vscode-scrollbar
```

## How it works

The conversation scroll container ships no stable class name — its classes are CSS-module hashes
(`_727C8a_scrollBody`) that change between builds. It does ship a stable DOM contract, though: every
conversation body renders as a `[data-slot="conversation.session"]` element, and the shared shell
itself styles that relationship (its composer-overlay rules already use
`[data-slot="conversation.session"]`). Both halves start from that anchor.

**Scrollbar**

1. find each `[data-slot="conversation.session"]` anchor,
2. walk up to the nearest ancestor whose computed `overflow-y` is `auto`/`scroll` — that is the chat
   scroll container,
3. tag it with `data-dsh-vscode-scrollbar`, and
4. let a scoped stylesheet own `::-webkit-scrollbar*` for the tagged element only.

The stylesheet also carries a `:has(> [data-slot="conversation.session"])` selector branch, so the
bar renders correctly even before the marker is applied.

**Minimap**

1. A fixed-position layer is appended to `document.body` and placed from the scroll container's
   `getBoundingClientRect()`: flush against the 14px bar (`right - scrollbarWidth - 80px`), with the
   container's top, the container's width, and a height capped at half the window (or the container
   height when that is shorter). It is `z-index:30`, read-only and never takes layout space. While it
   is shown, a stylesheet rule parks Harness's turn-navigation rail (`nav[aria-label="轮次导航"]`) at
   `right:110px`, clear of the 80px column; with the column hidden the rail returns to its stock
   `right:12px`.
2. The chat column is measured on the **live** tree: every message row is a `[data-chat-flow-kind]`
   flex child of a column capped at `max-width: var(--dsh-chat-content-width)` and centred, so a
   rendered row reports the column width exactly. Measuring the clone instead would be wrong — the
   clone is detached from the ancestors that publish that CSS variable, so its rows reflow to the
   full pane width.
3. The anchor is cloned, sanitized in one tree walk, and given its own layout box: slot anchors render
   with `display: contents` (the outlet wrapper takes no box), so the clone is forced to
   `display: block`, sized from the pane's content width, and handed the measured column width as
   `--dsh-chat-content-width`. It is appended untransformed first, because the natural height is what
   the preview is fitted to.
4. The clone is transformed with `scale(sx, sy) translate(-columnLeft, 0)`: `sx = 80px / columnWidth`
   and `sy = columnHeight / naturalHeight`, so the whole conversation fills the (capped) column the way
   VS Code's minimap fits a file into its column. Images stay painted (a chat minimap with empty holes

plugins.description: Japanese (日本語) interface for the dsh-advisor settings page - a standalone DeepSeek Harness client plugin
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-advisor-locale-ja [dsh-advisor](https://github.com/KnameSk/dsh-advisor) の **Advisor 設定画面を日本語化する**、独立した DSH プラグイン
## 概要 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）の **Advisor 設定画面**の文字列だけを日本語にします。 - **設定**・**相談予算**・**履歴**・**接続テスト**のタブと、その中にある項目名・説明・ボタン・エラー・確認メッセージを日本語化します。 - 翻訳がない項目は **英語でそのまま表示**されます（英語へのフォールバック）。 - **Advisor 本体とは独立**してインストール・アンインストールできます。 - **DSH 標準の言語設定に連動**します。DSH の言語が日本語のときだけ日本語で表示され、English や 中文 に戻せば元の表示に戻ります。 - **Advisor 本体の機能には一切影響しません。** このプラグインは翻訳の登録だけを行い、Advisor の設定値・相談処理・モデル呼び出しには触れません。 - 既存の翻訳辞書を壊したり上書きしたりしません。 ## 対応環境 - DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` - `dsh-advisor` `0.2.0` 以降 ## インストール GitHub から直接インストールできます。`` は実際に使用しているプロファイル名（`web` / `desktop` など）に置き換えてください。 ```bash dsh plugin --profile add github:KnameSk/dsh-advisor-locale-ja ``` **配布物として受け取る場合は、バージョンをタグで固定してください。** `main` を指すインストールは後日の変更で中身が変わるため、再現性がありません。公開済みのタグは変更されません。 ```bash dsh plugin --profile add github:KnameSk/dsh-advisor-locale-ja#v0.1.0 ``` アンインストールする場合は、次のコマンドを実行します。 ```bash dsh plugin --profile remove dsh-advisor-locale-ja ``` ## 使い方 1. DSH の **アカウントメニュー → Settings → General → Language**（**設定 → 一般 → 言語**）を開きます。 2. **日本語** を選びます。 3. **Settings → Advisor** を開くと、Advisor 設定画面が日本語で表示されます。 日本語を選ぶ手段は 2 通りあり、どちらでも動作します。 | 構成 | 日本語の選択肢を提供するもの | このプラグインの役割 | | --- | --- | --- | | `dsh-locale-ja` を併用 | [`@fang2hou/dsh-locale-ja`](https://github.com/fang2hou/dsh-locale-ja) | Advisor の辞書だけを追加 | | このプラグイン単体 | `dsh-advisor-locale-ja` | Advisor の辞書を追加し、**日本語の選択肢も追加** | `dsh-locale-ja` を併用する場合、このプラグインは **言語の定義を再登録しません**。言語の定義は `dsh-locale-ja` が所有し、このプラグインは Advisor の辞書だけを担当します。これにより、どちらのプラグインを先に読み込んでも衝突しません。 ## 翻訳の範囲 | 対象 | 翻訳 | | --- | --- | | Advisor 設定画面（`settings.advisor` 名前空間） | する | | DSH 全体の UI | しない | | Advisor の設定値・動作 | しない（文字列のみ） | `Advisor`・`Executor`・`Provider`・`block-tool`・`provider/model`・`/advisor`・`API`・`JSON`・`USD` などの識別子は、原文のまま表示します。 ##
